title: TST versus IGRA versus TBST
dek: Three ways to ask whether T cells remember Mtb antigens. None diagnoses disease. BCG, boosting, and anergy are the failure modes.
story: The tuberculin skin test (Mantoux) injects PPD intradermally and reads millimetres of induration at 48–72 h. Cut-points shift with HIV, contacts, and BCG policy. PPD contains antigens shared with BCG and many NTM, so false positives follow vaccination and environmental mycobacteria.

IGRAs (QFT-Plus, T-SPOT.TB) stimulate blood with ESAT-6 and CFP-10 (RD1 peptides BCG lacks). They are in-tube ELISA or ELISPOT IFN-γ readouts. They avoid most BCG false positives. They still fail in anergy, very young infants, and some extrapulmonary/overwhelming disease.

Mycobacterium tuberculosis antigen-based skin tests (TBST) are the new WHO-permitted skin-test class using Mtb-specific antigens. Same job as IGRA: infer infection after disease is excluded. Serial testing, conversion, and boosting still require a protocol, not vibes.
deep: WHO 2024 TPT module: test for infection when it changes the TPT decision. In high-transmission HIV clinics, TPT may proceed without a test if disease is ruled out — do not weaponise IGRA stockouts against prevention.
QFT-Plus split CD4/CD8 tubes are not a CD4 count and not a disease test.

Two-step TST for baseline in serial-testing adults (HCWs) reduces boosting misread as conversion. IGRAs have their own reproducibility noise around the cut-point; grey-zone policies exist for a reason.
A positive infection test plus a cavity is still a disease work-up, not “LTBI with a funny X-ray.”

visual.caption: Schematic specificity against BCG and sensitivity in advanced HIV — teaching bars, not a pooled meta-analysis. Disease diagnosis is a different test class.

example.title: Conversion after two-step miss
example.setup: New HCW, no two-step baseline, TST 0 mm at hire, 14 mm at year 1 after BCG in childhood. QFT negative.

steps.title: Boosting vs conversion
steps.body: A single baseline TST can miss remote memory that boosts on the second test. That is why two-step exists.

steps.title: IGRA as arbiter in BCG-vaccinated adults
steps.body: Negative QFT plus BCG history makes remote boosting more likely than incident infection, depending on exposure.

steps.title: Still exclude disease
steps.body: Symptom/CXR screen before you argue about millimetres.

example.takeaway: Skin tests remember BCG; IGRAs remember RD1 — neither remembers a cavity.

check.prompt: A positive IGRA in a person with cough and a cavity:
choices: Shows T-cell sensitisation; it does not diagnose disease or replace NAAT/culture
Rules out TB because IGRAs are disease tests
check.answer: Shows T-cell sensitisation; it does not diagnose disease or replace NAAT/culture
check.why: Stop using infection tests as disease tests.

check.prompt: An adult received neonatal BCG. TST 11 mm, QFT-Plus negative, no exposure, normal CXR. The pattern is most consistent with:
choices: BCG-related TST reactivity with a negative RD1 IGRA, not microbiologic disease
Failed Xpert because IGRAs replace WRDs
check.answer: BCG-related TST reactivity with a negative RD1 IGRA, not microbiologic disease
check.why: RD1 antigens are deleted in BCG.

check.prompt: On the small-multiples plate, what are the “diagnose disease?” bars teaching?
choices: That IGRAs are twice as good as NAAT at diagnosing cavities
That neither TST nor IGRA is a disease diagnostic — both bars sit at the floor
That BCG raises IGRA specificity above TST
check.answer: That neither TST nor IGRA is a disease diagnostic — both bars sit at the floor

whyWrong.That BCG raises IGRA specificity above T: That is panel one, not panel three.
